specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V, up to 400 MHz; single-core 32-bit LP RISC-V, up to 40 MHz

specs.name: RAM
specs.value: 768 KB HP L2MEM + 32 KB LP SRAM + 8 KB SPM; 32MB in-package PSRAM

specs.name: WiFi/BT
specs.value: WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE 5 (optional, ESP32-C6 is not mounted by default)

specs.name: 4G/LTE
specs.value: Internal Cat 1 4G/LTE module, not mounted by default

specs.name: Camera
specs.value: 1 x MIPI-CSI (2-lane) interface for connecting a MIPI-CSI (2-lane) 15-pin 1.0mm camera such as a Raspberry Pi (OV5647) Camera V1.3 (optional, not mounted by default)

specs.name: RS232
specs.value: 2 x RS232 (default); up to 4 x RS232 (optional, by configuring RS485 to RS232)

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: 2 x RS485 (default); 2 x RS485 can be configured to 2 x RS232 (optional), 120Ohm terminal resistor is NOT mounted by default, if you need it, please note us

specs.name: CAN
specs.value: 1 x CAN (default), bit rate up to 1Mbps, 120Ohm terminal resistor is NOT mounted by default, if you need it, please note us

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 2.0 Type-A high-speed host ports; 1 x USB 1.1 Type-C port for firmware flashing and debugging; the type-C port supports powering the device while programming

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High-accuracy RTC with supercapacitor, can work 1 week after power off
